pokedexEntries.su: One of the dangerous Ultra Beasts, it has been spotted running across the land at terrific speeds.

pokedexEntries.mo: One of the Ultra Beasts. It refuses to touch anything, perhaps because it senses some uncleanness in this world.

pokedexEntries.us: A life-form that lives in another world, its body is thin and supple, but it also possesses great power.

pokedexEntries.um: Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.
